decided: When a project signs off at every change's archive, the archive goes on only after the user's answer has been recorded; if recording it fails, the archive stops. If the latest sign-off record cannot be read or is damaged, the archive stops, naming that record and saying which of the two it is, and never treats an older recorded sign-off as the current one.
alternatives: go on with the archive when the answer could not be recorded
fall back to the latest sign-off that can still be read
why: A sign-off that was never recorded cannot be shown later, and an older recorded sign-off may cover different text or have been followed by a decline; stopping and naming the problem keeps the wait the project asked for.
